title: Choose the visual world
question: Re-roll. The new assignment is Host Console. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: Host Console
options.lineage: Kernel serial / UART host log: amber phosphor, typed grants, no chrome
options.thesis: The page is the host log the Preview already is: the first line admits it is not a bootable OS, then grants type in, then the install command sits on the prompt.
options.viewport: Full-bleed console: honesty line already printed, a grant net typing in as the only bright trace, `install` as the live prompt at the bottom.
options.risk: Reads as generic hacker-terminal if the glow is decoration and the lines are not real product facts.

raised.raise: THE LIVE LINE IS THE ONLY BRIGHT TRACE — dim history above, one amber grant line at full intensity.
ONE SCROLL ADVANCES THE LOG — the visitor cranks the UART; they do not hunt marketing sections.
GRANTS ARE WRITTEN ON THE SURFACE — capabilities are log lines, not a sidebar of tiles.

options.label: Interlocking Frame
options.lineage: Railway signal-box interlocking: levers, locked routes, red/clear lamps
options.thesis: An agent may only take a route the frame has unlocked; conflicting capabilities cannot be pulled at once.
options.viewport: A row of named levers (session, gpu, net, audit); net is locked; Download is pulling the Preview route.
options.risk: Also a familiar ‘serious infrastructure’ landing — the direction many systems products drift toward.

options.label: Traveled Passport
options.lineage: Well-traveled passport: visa plates, entry stamps, security paper
options.thesis: Each Preview power is an entry stamp; the data page states the limit: host app, not a bootable OS.
options.viewport: Open booklet: OCR identity line, a restriction stamp, then stamps for gpu / audit / net:deny.
options.case: Holds product clarity (grant as official mark); loses audience identification (borders are a metaphor, the tester is at a GPU desk).
options.risk: Becomes travel-brand chrome if stamps decorate instead of recording real limits.

options.label: Shoebox Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard: one-bit cards, painted buttons, browse and author as one
options.thesis: A stack of addressable cards — thesis, grant, install — linked by visible buttons, no color anywhere.
options.viewport: Card 1 is the honesty line and a fat button to the grant card; Download is a painted button on the last card.
options.case: Holds product clarity (one card, one job); loses audience identification (classic Mac, not Windows/Linux NVIDIA testers).
options.risk: Nostalgia toy if the cards are cute instead of carrying the protocol.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope: phosphor trace, etched graticule, detented knobs
options.thesis: Semantic IPC is a locked trace on a ten-division graticule; ungranted nets roll as noise.
options.viewport: One screen: a triggered grant waveform standing still; amber readout says net:deny; Download is arming the trigger.
options.case: Holds audience identification (bench people with NVIDIA); loses product clarity (a waveform must be translated before the tester knows what to install).
options.risk: A pretty trace that never states the thesis in words.

options.label: Salt Map
options.lineage: Salt-stiffened treasure map, false trails, oblique light
options.thesis: The tester infers a hidden route to the real OS.
options.viewport: A torn chart; a faded red route under oblique light.
options.case: Loses both: pirate inference fights the honesty brief, and the audience is not navigating a harbor.
options.kept: One bright route under dim history — donated as THE LIVE LINE IS THE ONLY BRIGHT TRACE.
options.risk: Mystery where the product needs a plain admission.

options.label: Paper Menagerie
options.thesis: A crank advances thesis, grant, and install as linked figures.
options.viewport: A procession on a crank line; the live figure is crimson.
options.case: Loses both: toy identification, and paper animals cannot carry Preview limits.
options.kept: One crank advances the whole — donated as ONE SCROLL ADVANCES THE LOG.
options.risk: A charming machine that forgets the OS.

options.label: Living Skin
options.thesis: The surface itself signals grant and deny by changing pattern.
options.viewport: A pale field that becomes waves when the grant is live.
options.case: Loses both: biology-art identification, and camouflage contradicts honesty.
options.kept: Signals written on the body — donated as GRANTS ARE WRITTEN ON THE SURFACE.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark AI-OS landing: kicker, centered hero, four feature cards, dual CTA, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects from an agent-product site.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design — the wrapper look testers were told to refuse.
